mails.subject: Documents required: Northgate Maritime Holdings Ltd
mails.body:
Dear client,

As part of our customer due diligence obligations, we kindly ask you to provide the following documents by 14/10/2026:

1. Certified register extract (less than 3 months old)
2. Articles of association (up-to-date version)
3. Beneficial ownership declaration / UBO register extract
4. Identity documents of the legal representatives
5. Identity document and proof of address of Ruslan Terekhov
6. Passport copy of Ruslan Terekhov (full date of birth and nationality)
7. Register extract of TVKvExchangeSanctDEM11111111111111 (registration number, registered office, directors) and its link with the client
8. Explanation and transaction history for the flows with the sanctioned wallet(s)
9. Group structure chart down to the natural persons, dated and signed by the client
10. Explanation of the difference between declared and computed beneficial owners, and updated UBO declaration
11. Register extract and register of directors / members of Northgate Maritime Holdings Ltd (British Virgin Islands)
12. Register extract and register of directors / members of Solenne Holdings Ltd (Cyprus)
13. Latest audited financial statements
14. Nominee agreement or declaration of the person on whose behalf the director acts
15. Purpose and economic rationale of the offshore structure(s) found in leaks, with their financial statements
16. Explanation of the business links with the high-risk countries, and origin of the funds involved
17. Certificate of incumbency from the registered agent
18. Evidence of real activity (contracts, invoices, lease, payroll)
19. Domiciliation contract and proof of physical premises
20. Business plan and expected account activity (volumes, counterparties, countries)

Register extracts and proofs of address should be less than 3 months old, and copies certified where applicable.

Thank you for your cooperation.
Kind regards,
